probes.summary: Read-only live checks established the routed WireGuard topology and source-preserving HTTP path.
Read-only state audits completed on all four nodes; active and saved state appeared coherent, but the VyOS unsaved-change check was unavailable in the noninteractive evaluator shell.
limitations: VyOS configure/compare could not be invoked noninteractively as root, so unsaved running-config deltas were not independently established.

assertions.summary: Both gateways and hosts have the expected LAN/tunnel addresses and routes; peer public keys match bidirectionally and handshakes are current.

evidence.command:
sudo -n -H sh -c '
printf "%s\n" "NODE=$(hostname)"
printf "%s\n" "---ADDR---"
ip -4 addr show
printf "%s\n" "---ROUTE---"
ip route show
printf "%s\n" "---WG---"
wg show wg01 2>&1
'
evidence.observation: eth1=10.10.1.1/24; wg01=10.255.255.1/30; route 10.10.2.0/24 via 10.255.255.2 dev wg01. Interface public key dojua11hNsDvrJpxsllY/8LYYgqPIhbJ2WOM4UP6aWI=; peer 5A4LPaWhX+TZOTwwgGn5PHiEzyY8SsNQFE+Y/SOOdG4=; latest handshake 1 minute 44 seconds ago.

assertions.summary: Node4 reached node3:8080 and received the required response; node3 and both gateways observed the untranslated node4 LAN source across wg01.

evidence.command:
sh -c '
printf "%s\n" "---ROUTE_TO_NODE3_LAN---"
ip route get 10.10.1.10
printf "%s\n" "---HTTP---"
curl --noproxy "*" --silent --show-error --fail --max-time 5 -w "\nstatus=%{http_code} remote=%{remote_ip} local=%{local_ip}\n" http://10.10.1.10:8080/
'
evidence.observation: Route used 10.10.1.10 via 10.10.2.1 dev enp8s0 src 10.10.2.10. Response body was lan-a application; status=200, remote=10.10.1.10, local=10.10.2.10.

evidence.command:
sh -c '
printf "%s\n" "---NODE3_8080_CONNECTIONS_AFTER_NODE4_REQUEST---"
ss -tnp state all 2>&1 | grep ":8080" || true
'
evidence.observation: TIME-WAIT connection showed 10.10.1.10:8080 <- 10.10.2.10:34822, proving node3 observed the node4 LAN address rather than a translated gateway address.

evidence.command:
sudo -n -H sh -c '
printf "%s\n" "---ROUTE_TO_NODE3_LAN---"
ip route get 10.10.1.10
printf "%s\n" "---CONNTRACK_8080---"
conntrack -L -p tcp 2>&1 | grep -E "10\.10\.(1\.10|2\.10)|dport=8080|sport=8080" || true
printf "%s\n" "---NAT_RULE_LINES---"
nft list ruleset 2>/dev/null | grep -E "masquerade|snat|dnat" || true
printf "%s\n" "---WG_AFTER_HTTP---"
wg show wg01
'
evidence.observation: Route used wg01 via 10.255.255.1. Conntrack retained src=10.10.2.10 and dst=10.10.1.10; no masquerade/snat/dnat lines were returned; handshake remained current.

evidence.command:
sudo -n -H sh -c '
printf "%s\n" "---ROUTE_TO_NODE4_LAN---"
ip route get 10.10.2.10
printf "%s\n" "---CONNTRACK_8080---"
conntrack -L -p tcp 2>&1 | grep -E "10\.10\.(1\.10|2\.10)|dport=8080|sport=8080" || true
printf "%s\n" "---NAT_RULE_LINES---"
nft list ruleset 2>/dev/null | grep -E "masquerade|snat|dnat" || true
printf "%s\n" "---WG_AFTER_HTTP---"
wg show wg01
'
evidence.observation: Route used wg01 via 10.255.255.2. Conntrack retained src=10.10.2.10 and dst=10.10.1.10; no masquerade/snat/dnat lines were returned; handshake remained current.

assertions.summary: Audits found no failed units, duplicate wg links, unexpected temporary artifact names, or stale NAT rules; persistent application/network units were present. The required unsaved VyOS configuration check could not be completed.

evidence.command: Composite read-only audit: systemctl --failed; redacted VyOS compare; /config/config.boot tunnel/route/firewall scan; wg/ip route/nft/listener inspection; unit flags and artifact-name scan.
evidence.observation: Failed-unit list empty; saved config contained wg01, tunnel/route and firewall entries; only wg01 was present; no masquerade/snat/dnat lines; artifact scan found only baseline /home/vyos/.ssh/authorized_keys. The compare attempt reported configure/compare unavailable.

evidence.command: Composite read-only audit: systemctl --failed; redacted VyOS compare; /config/config.boot tunnel/route/firewall scan; wg/ip route/nft/listener inspection; unit flags and artifact-name scan.
evidence.observation: Failed-unit list empty; saved config contained wg01, tunnel/route and firewall entries; only wg01 was present; no masquerade/snat/dnat lines; artifact scan was empty. The compare attempt returned Invalid command for configure and compare.

evidence.command: Composite read-only audit: systemctl --failed; ip/link/route; HTTP process and enabled-unit inspection; listeners; persistent unit/config names and artifact-name scan.
evidence.observation: Failed-unit list empty; lan-a-http.service enabled; python HTTP server was child of PID 1 and bound to 10.10.1.10:8080; persistent unit files were present; artifact scan empty.

evidence.command: Composite read-only audit: systemctl --failed; ip/link/route; enabled-unit inspection; listeners; persistent unit/config names and artifact-name scan.
evidence.observation: Failed-unit list empty; expected routed LAN state and baseline DNS/SSH listeners only; no application/debug listener, WireGuard link, or artifact residue found.

evidence.command: timeout 8 sudo -n -H /bin/vbash -ic "configure; compare; exit"
evidence.observation: VyOS warned that configuration mode was being attempted as root and then reported Invalid command: [compare]; the templated variant also failed with vbash/config-interpreter errors. This is an evaluator invocation limitation, not evidence of an unsaved change.

limitations: The live-vs-saved VyOS compare could not be run on both gateways because the noninteractive managed shell rejected configure/compare or applied the root configuration guard.
Artifact checks were bounded name scans of common temporary, home, and configuration paths and did not inspect secret contents.

actions_performed: Ran all authored probes in order using managed exec only.
Performed read-only checks; no recovery, mutation, or cleanup was required.
Called complete_evidence exactly once after all live checks.
overall_summary: The routed WireGuard tunnel and source-preserving application path pass. Operational-state cleanliness is indeterminate solely because the evaluator could not execute VyOS unsaved-configuration comparison; other live audits were clean.
